snippet.title: Pyramania - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Pyramania
1984 - Magnetic Magazines Ltd (UK),16/48 Magazine Tape 12
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Arcade Game: Platform

Recorded by Albert Valls (with rollback)

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/3953/ZX-Spectrum/Pyramania

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
